messages:
maria: hey all — first day! trying to boot the mono-repo. hitting weird asdf shims + direnv (.envrc) ordering on my M2 mac. quick steps I ran: `brew install asdf direnv 1password-cli`, added node/python/go/rust via asdf, then `direnv allow` at the repo root. Now when I cd into packages/foo I get `command not found: yarn` even though packages/foo/.tool-versions exists and root .tool-versions has node 18. Any pointers?

devon: welcome! common pitfalls: asdf needs its init hooked into your shell (so shims are on PATH) and direnv needs to run after that. Check you have `eval "$(asdf init -)"` (or `source /opt/homebrew/opt/asdf/libexec/asdf.sh`) in your shell rc, and `eval "$(direnv hook zsh)"` for zsh. Also run `asdf reshim` after installs.

ryan: +1. If you're using zsh or fish the init lines differ — for zsh add these to ~/.zshrc: `source /opt/homebrew/opt/asdf/libexec/asdf.sh` and `eval "$(direnv hook zsh)"`. For bash use `eval "$(direnv hook bash)"`.

maria: I do have those lines. Still seeing one package pick node16 while root says 18. How do I get auto-switching when I cd into packages/<pkg>?

devon: direnv + asdf usually handles this if there's a .tool-versions in the package. Two things to check: 1) direnv runs in that directory (run `direnv status`), and 2) the package has a .envrc that either loads .tool-versions or allows direnv to pick it up. We sometimes add a tiny `.envrc` in each package with `layout node` or `use asdf` helper. If you rely only on .tool-versions, make sure `ASDF_DIR`/shims are on PATH before direnv manipulates PATH.

samir: FYI we ship a small helper script in the mono-repo: `scripts/setup-dev.sh`. It bootstraps asdf plugins, runs `asdf plugin add` for missing ones, and populates per-package .envrc stubs so direnv will switch versions. Run `./scripts/setup-dev.sh --quick` after installing asdf.

maria: ran it, thanks — that fixed node switching. New issue: python venvs. Poetry creates envs under `~/.cache/pypoetry/...` and they don't use the asdf-provided python. Poetry sees system python. How should I make poetry use asdf python?

ryan: Poetry picks the `python` on PATH. Confirm `which python` is the asdf shim, e.g. `~/.asdf/shims/python`. If not, `asdf global python 3.11.6` (or whatever we pin) and `asdf reshim`. Then in the package dir run `poetry env use $(which python)`. That forces poetry to create the venv with the asdf python.

infra-bot: Reminder: to access private registries and internal services you need the corporate VPN + client cert. Please start the VPN and add the corp cert to your keychain if prompted: `open /Applications/CorpVPN.app` and then `security add-trusted-cert -d -r trustRoot -k ~/Library/Keychains/login.keychain-db corp-vpn-cert.pem`.

maria: oh right, i forgot `op signin` too — how do we surface secrets in dev without committing them to .envrc?

devon: we store secrets in 1Password and use `op` to fetch them at runtime. Example snippet we keep out of repo and reference in .envrc.local (ignored): `export DATABASE_URL=$(op read "op://redwood/dev/db/connection_string")`. You'll need to run `eval $(op signin --account redwood)` first. Never commit credentials; use `.envrc.local` or direnv to read op.

samir: also, for dotfiles we use chezmoi. If you want our standard dev dotfiles run: `chezmoi init git@github.com:redwood/dotfiles.git && chezmoi apply`. That sets sane defaults (asdf init lines, direnv hook, git config, etc).

maria: last couple Qs: 1) GPG git signing fails for me (pinentry issues), and 2) direnv prompted to trust root .envrc — should I?

ryan: for gpg on mac ensure pinentry-mac is installed and referenced in `~/.gnupg/gpg-agent.conf`: `pinentry-program /opt/homebrew/bin/pinentry-mac` (or where brew put it). Restart gpg-agent after editing. For commit signing docs we have a short guide at docs/onboarding/gpg.md — follow the mac section.

devon: about trusting root .envrc: yes, you should trust the repo root .envrc for dev machines; it only sets PATH tweaks, NODE_ENV=development, and loads local helpers. Inspect it if you're paranoid. If it changes later git will show you and you'll have to run `direnv allow` again.

maria: awesome — running through the checklist now (setup script, op signin, vpn, chezmoi). will ping if anything else breaks. Thanks everyone! :party_popper:
